reason: I lose after-hours enquiries to competitors and my site chat goes unanswered at night. If it books into my calendar and only costs $49 a month, that is cheaper than one missed booking.
objection: What if the AI gives a patient wrong information about prices, treatments or availability? One bad answer about a procedure could cost me a complaint or a bad review.
would_change_my_mind: A way to review and approve what it learned from my site, plus a clear record of every chat it handled, so I can see its wrong answers before a patient does.
